description: Prepares a recording in Underway from the choices a founder has made: how long, camera or podcast, portrait or landscape, questions or just talking, and what it is about. Returns a one-line description of the setup and a link that opens Underway set up that way. It records nothing and runs no interview. Use it when the founder wants to film in Underway and has said how; to talk through their day here instead, use underway_debrief.

clock.description: How long. One of: short (about a minute, two at most); standard (about three minutes, five at most); long (up to ten minutes, as long as you like).

format.description: The shape. One of: portrait (The episode: The usual debrief: one thread of the day, a few questions.); podcast (Just my voice: No camera. An audio interview, or a podcast with the AI co-host. The same episode, as sound.). Leave it out to keep the founder's usual.

frame.description: Portrait for a reel, landscape for a longer piece. Not used by a podcast.

questions.description: true to be interviewed, false to just talk with no question list. Leave it out to keep the founder's usual.

topic.description: One line on what it is about, in the founder's own words.

name: underway_set_up_recording

link.description: Opens Underway set up and ready to film.

notes.description: Anything that could not be set, in plain words.

title: Set up a recording
